findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_icons, get_popular_icons, get_icon_svg, get_icon_png, list_categories · Private data: search_icons, get_icon_png, search_uicons · Public sink: get_icon_png · Destructive: get_related_icons.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_icons, get_popular_icons, get_icon_svg, get_icon_png, list_categories · Private data: search_icons, get_icon_png, search_uicons · Public sink: get_icon_png · Destructive: get_related_icons

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
